source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-14

procedures.title: Brake pedal: remove and install
steps: Manual transmission: connect the clutch push rod to the pedal bracket, fit the retainer and hook up the clutch pedal return spring.
Adjust brake pedal free travel (see this section), the stoplight switch (Section 6Y) and clutch pedal travel (Section 7).
notes: The drum brake shoe and lining service that begins on this page applies to drum-brake models only and is not included.
